title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Psalms 17: a righteous plea, being kept as the apple of God's eye, and enemies like a greedy lion.

questions.text: What does the psalmist say his prayer does not go out of?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:1 asks Yahweh to hear his prayer, that doesn't go out of deceitful lips.

questions.text: When does the psalmist say God visited him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:3 says, "You have visited me in the night."

questions.text: What did God find when he tried the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:3 says, "You have tried me, and found nothing."

questions.text: What does the psalmist say about his feet?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:5 says his steps have held fast to God's paths and his feet have not slipped.

answers.text: They are tired from the journey

questions.text: How does the psalmist ask God to keep him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:8 says, "Keep me as the apple of your eye."

answers.text: As a lamb in his arms
As the apple of his eye
As a seal on his hand
As a jewel in his crown

questions.text: Under what does the psalmist ask to be hidden?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:8 says, "Hide me under the shadow of your wings."

questions.text: What do the psalmist's enemies close up?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:10 says, "They close up their callous hearts."

questions.text: To what is the enemy compared in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:12 says he is like a lion that is greedy of his prey.

answers.text: A bear robbed of her cubs
A lion greedy of his prey

questions.text: By what does the psalmist ask Yahweh to deliver his soul from the wicked?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:13 says, "Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword."

questions.text: With what shall the psalmist be satisfied when he awakes?
questions.explanation: Psalms 17:15 says, "I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form."
